title: Trump executed 22,000 crypto trades in 2025
title_zh: 特朗普在 2025 年执行了 22,000 笔加密货币交易
summary: Scott Melker discusses President Trump's crypto trading earnings after the president made more than 22,000 crypto trades in 2025. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.
summary_zh: Scott Melker 讨论了特朗普总统在 2025 年进行了超过 22,000 笔加密货币交易后的加密货币交易收入。“The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker”每天中午 12:00 播出。请关注您每天对加密事物的了解。
